text:
Plate looks like about 22-24 cm across. The pear (a Asian/nashi pear) is about 7-8 cm across, so roughly 180-200 g, at about 45 kcal per 100 g, giving about 85 kcal.

Bread: two slices, each about 11x11 cm, so about 30 g each, 60 g total, at about 2.6 kcal/g, giving about 160 kcal. Jam on one slice is about 20 g, adding about 50 kcal.

Total mass is about 190 + 60 + 20 = 270 g, and total energy is about 85 + 160 + 50 = 295 kcal.
